scope: Observed selected SN-host photometry support across DES, available SNLS/JLA and SDSS high-z catalogues; exact identity linkage; no redshift-to-age substitution.
discovery_before_outcomes: Inspect primary release schemas and units, acquire observed fluxes and uncertainties plus catalogued host/SN IDs, redshifts and masks.
Pin source bytes and release versions; missing covariance remains explicit.
primary_analysis: Audit unique SN/host grain, missing flux/errors, negative measurements and upper limits, host matching and release selection.
Use finite positive-error flux likelihood in native observed filters; negative flux stays valid. No raw observed colour comparison across unmatched rest wavelengths.
DES within-survey observed support: low .06<=z<.3, mid .3<=z<.6, high .6<=z<=1.2, no outcome-based bin change; survey metadata subsets reported.
For each band and rest-wavelength coverage, report detectability, colour covariance and proxy support; report inferred rest-frame quantities separately as model dependent.
Evaluate cross-survey overlap only for physically compatible observables; survey/field heldout validation, exact-host grouping, 500 physical-SN bootstrap if identifiable.
No physical progenitor age correction without independent age likelihood and selected-population model; conditional SED sensitivity should carry selection and covariance assumptions.
